mece.dimension: Steps of the organisation review workflow
mece.rationale: Separate model or signal interpretation, controlled comparison, constraints and the final record.

objectives.statement: Apply the illustrative organisation review process to a saved case.
Produce a justified case review and a plan for practice.
Diagnose the missing hook in the case segment.
Apply the agency planning constraints to a slow segment.
Diagnose the sequence of chat and viewer changes in the case.
Apply the agency participation rule during a slow segment.
Calculate the agency segment retention ratio from case endpoints.
Distinguish aggregate viewer counts from individual retention and causal evidence.
Design a single-change agency experiment with an explicit measure.
Identify confounders when interpreting a later result.

mece.rationale: Each concept owns its terms and its assessment evidence.

concepts.title: Give every slow segment a reason to stay
Read chat as an early warning, then verify
Compare segments without mistaking counts for people
Propose one change and a measurable review
